stories.new_fact: OpenAI described GPT-5.6 Sol’s use in a coordinated PHP vulnerability discovery and remediation effort alongside Calif, Wiz and PHP maintainers.
stories.new_takeaway: Agent-assisted discovery is useful evidence for security triage, not a general proof of autonomous remediation reliability.
stories.why_now: The primary security case was published October 21.
stories.previous_coverage: No compared episode covered this coordinated-disclosure case.
stories.uncertainty: No controlled baseline, false-positive rate, scan population or missed-bug measure is published.
stories.watch: Transparent multi-codebase evaluation with detection quality and analyst-time results.
stories.measured_by: OpenAI reports its role; Wiz independently discovered and reported both vulnerabilities; no controlled quantitative comparison is published.
stories.bridge: A regulated bank could first use this approach in isolated internal application-security triage, gated by validated findings and controlled code access.

editorial_review.notes: Eight candidates were independently discovered before consulting the tracker. Five selected story cards have October 21-23 developments; the national and Central Ohio segments use different audience takeaways from one fresh local political event. The lending effective-date story concerns loan-delivery continuity. The banking item is explicitly reported risk rather than a deployment claim, and the frontier item separates OpenAI’s account, Wiz’s independent discovery and maintainer remediation from a general reliability conclusion. Script has 1,700 spoken words, a 26.9% cohost share, seven unique chapters, three closing watch items, AI in Banking at 320 words, and Frontier AI at 306 words.
